evidence.notes: Accepted author manuscript, Results pages 4-5, Discussion pages 6-7, Figure 2 and Table 1. Donor, host background and derivative are distinct; the coarse route is the authors' interpretation. Supplements were not inspected.

claims.label: ptmP3-associated reported resistance to platencin in a laboratory Streptomyces albus derivative
claims.note: Primary functional evidence in a laboratory S. albus derivative; S. albus J1074 is the host background, not the derivative. Streptomyces platensis MA7327 is the native donor, not the tested host. The coarse route follows the authors' interpretation; it is not an independent kinetic or exact-allele validation. Donor reference UniProtKB:D8L2W8 (entry version 45, sequence version 1; EMBL:FJ655920 / ACS13710.1) matches the paper's PtmP3 archive accession. This is not an experimental construct or allele assignment. PtnP3 is not substituted for the tested PtmP3. NCBITaxon:58346 is a donor species reference; NCBITaxon:1888 is a host species-name reference. The J1074 taxonomy search is ambiguous. No exact allele, strain TaxID, genome, numerical AST or clinical category is assigned.

claims.label: fabF-associated partial resistance / reduced susceptibility to platencin in a laboratory Streptomyces albus derivative
claims.note: Primary functional evidence in a laboratory S. albus derivative; S. albus J1074 is the host background, not the derivative. Streptomyces platensis MA7327 is the native donor, not the tested host. The coarse route follows the authors' interpretation; it is not an independent kinetic or exact-allele validation. The paper reports donor gene archive KF543053; no matching UniProt protein was resolved. Same-species DSM 40041 proteins are not MA7327 assignments. The precise basis of the reported intrinsic insensitivity is unresolved. The partial platencin response is not equivalent to full resistance. NCBITaxon:58346 is a donor species reference; NCBITaxon:1888 is a host species-name reference. The J1074 taxonomy search is ambiguous. No exact allele, strain TaxID, genome, numerical AST or clinical category is assigned.

curation_event.changes: Added two qualitative primary-paper resistance claims, preserving donor/background/derivative identity and the compound-specific response. Existing MIBiG producer and chemical evidence preserved; whole-record review remains open.
